notes: Rates (same for all filing statuses) and 2026 standard deduction ($16,100 / $32,200 / $24,150) are from OTR's 2026 D-40ES worksheet (April 2026).

DC's 2026 standard deduction is unsettled: for 2025 DC decoupled from the OBBBA increase ($15,000 / $30,000 / $22,500). Congress disapproved the Council's broader decoupling act (H.J.Res. 142, signed February 18, 2026); the Council then enacted a narrower set of decoupling amendments in the July 2026 FY2027 Budget Support Act. OTR's 2026 estimated-tax worksheet uses the federal amounts shown; confirm when the 2026 D-40 is published.

Unincorporated Business Franchise Tax (UBT): a sole proprietor/single-member LLC with DC gross income over $12,000 generally must file Form D-30 and pay 8.25% on business income after a 30%-of-net-income owner salary allowance and a $5,000 exemption (minimum tax $250, or $1,000 if DC gross receipts exceed $1 million); that income is then left off the D-40. Businesses where more than 80% of gross income comes from the owner's personal services and capital is not a material income-producing factor are exempt. Not modeled.
DC has no personal exemption. Itemized deduction limitation above $200,000 AGI, DC EITC, Schedule H property tax credit and other credits are not modeled.

seDeduction.note: DC starts from federal AGI (D-40 line 4), which already reflects the deductible half of SE tax.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions deducted in federal AGI carry through.

qbi.note: The QBI deduction is taken after federal AGI; DC has no equivalent.

localIncomeTax.note: DC is a single taxing jurisdiction; there is no separate local income tax (the UBT is described in income tax notes).

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if you must file a DC return and expect to owe $100 or more for 2026.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No underpayment interest if withholding, credits and estimated payments equal at least 90% of 2026 DC tax or 110% of 2025 DC tax (12-month year).

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $99 Certificate (Articles) of Organization for a domestic LLC, DC Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $300 biennial report, due April 1 of the year after registration and every two years thereafter ($100 late fee).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: Unincorporated Business Franchise Tax: 8.25% of DC taxable business income, minimum $250 ($1,000 if DC gross receipts exceed $1 million), for unincorporated businesses with gross income over $12,000; businesses deriving more than 80% of gross income from the owner's personal services with capital not material are exempt.
